name: Doctor's Best
founder: Ken Halvorsrude and Dr. James Braly
history: Doctor's Best was founded in 1990 by Ken Halvorsrude and Dr. James Braly; the company describes itself as founded by a physician. The private equity firm North Castle Partners acquired it in 2014 and sold it in June 2016 to Xiamen Kingdomway Group, a Chinese ingredient manufacturer and major producer of coenzyme Q10. Terms were not disclosed. Doctor's Best is now a subsidiary of Kingdomway USA and is based in Tustin, California, where its sister manufacturing company Vit-Best Nutrition also operates. It sells more than 200 products and acquired the Viactiv calcium chew brand in 2024.

positives.text: Its sister manufacturing company Vit-Best Nutrition in Tustin, California, appears on NSF's official NSF/ANSI 455-2 GMP listing (checked November 2026).
The company says its products are manufactured and tested exclusively at cGMP-certified facilities in the United States, and it has its own manufacturing arm, Vit-Best.

negatives.text: In June 2014 Doctor's Best recalled 7,379 bottles of its Red Yeast Rice supplement because it contained undeclared lovastatin, a prescription cholesterol drug; the company reported no adverse events.

A 2020 class action (Casey v. Doctor's Best) alleged glucosamine products contained no glucosamine sulfate as labelled; it was settled in 2022 with refunds and label changes, without admitting wrongdoing.
Since June 2016 the brand has been owned by Xiamen Kingdomway Group, a Chinese ingredient manufacturer, which bought it from the private equity firm North Castle Partners.
